prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file exporting `ReplicaItem`, `ReplicaState`, `ReplicaChange`, and `applyReplicaChange`.

A state contains a nonnegative integer `revision` and a readonly item array. Each item has a non-blank string `id` and `value`. A change is one of `{ kind: "insert", revision, item }`, `{ kind: "delete", revision, id }`, or `{ kind: "replace", revision, items }`.

`applyReplicaChange(state, change)` must validate that state and change revisions are nonnegative integers and require `change.revision === state.revision + 1`; otherwise throw `RangeError`. Validate all IDs after trimming. Values may be empty and are preserved exactly. Existing state IDs must be unique. Insert rejects an existing ID; delete rejects an absent ID; replace rejects duplicate IDs. Such conflicts throw `Error`.

Insert appends, delete preserves relative order, and replace uses the supplied order. The returned state has the change revision. The function must not mutate or alias the state, change, items, or nested item objects, including when an error is thrown.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
